nodes.name: Sklearn Neural Network Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level MLPClassifier and MLPRegressor estimator-selection, optimizer-boundary, callback-payload, and fitted-state atoms above L-BFGS, SGD, Adam, backpropagation, early-stopping, prediction, and scoring execution.

nodes.name: mlp_public_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose public MLP estimator names useful for framework-level model selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: mlp_public_estimator_task
nodes.description: Return whether a public MLP estimator is a classifier or regressor.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: mlp_public_optimizer_boundary
nodes.description: Return the optimizer boundary selected by a public MLP estimator solver.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed solver labels.

nodes.name: mlp_public_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level MLP routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public-method tuple for each covered MLP estimator.

nodes.name: mlp_public_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public MLP fit payload for finite dense inputs without executing optimizer, backpropagation, or early-stopping callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, y: object, sample_weight: object = None) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense fit inputs and packages references without fitting the network.

nodes.name: mlp_public_prediction_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public MLP prediction-like method payload without executing prediction callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense prediction input and packages references, leaving prediction responses to sklearn.

nodes.name: mlp_public_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public MLP estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: mlp_public_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose fitted layer counts, output activation, coefficient and intercept shapes, iteration counts, optimizer metadata, and optional monitoring metadata after deferred sklearn MLP execution.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes already-fitted layer-shape metadata proportional to the number of network layers.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 2 and Case 4 public MLP estimator shells over L-BFGS, SGD, Adam, backpropagation, early-stopping, prediction, and scoring boundaries
limitations: The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact fitted-state packaging, not optimizer convergence, backpropagation gradients, parameter mutation, early-stopping validation, prediction, probability, or scoring internals.
Full training topology remains delegated to sklearn's L-BFGS, SGD, Adam, and MLP backpropagation implementation.
